svg.aria-label: Sketch: a portable highway message board on a trailer stands at the centre, its dark panel spelling MANDATORY EVACUATION OF HATTERAS VISITORS in dotted capitals; below the board three striped barricade drums and a row of traffic cones sit on the road shoulder, a small white sign on a post at left, and scribbled evergreens fill the background. No people and no faces. Drawn after an ABC News photograph.
